messages:
Maya (support): heads up — customer reported a hard break in their embedding pipeline after we applied a pinned model rollout this morning. their indexer throws: 'vector length mismatch: expected 1280 got 2048' when ingesting embeddings from /v1/embeddings. they had been using a pinned model version (open-embed-2-x.pinned) that we rolled to v3. Customer says it was working before the pin change. attaching logs below and sample requests.
Maya (support): paste of error from customer's indexer: 
```
ERROR: Indexer: insert failed for batch 42: vector length mismatch: expected 1280 got 2048 (model=open-embed-2-x.pinned, client_id=acme)
Stack: com.acme.indexer.VectorSizeException
```
Maya (support): sample request they sent (sanitized): 
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
{"model":"open-embed-2-x.pinned","input":["doc1","doc2"]}
Response: 200 OK
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,0.002,...(2048 floats)...]}]}
```
Devon (eng-ml): thanks maya. quick checks: 1) confirm model metadata (embedding_dim) for the pinned version, 2) check rollout timeline and whether pinned target changed commits. do we have the deploy id for that pin? maya, can you paste the model id and the pin id?
Maya (support): pin id: pin-09c3, model alias: open-embed-2-x.pinned, customer observed failure between 08:12 and 08:22 UTC. deploy-bot shows a canary -> main promotion at 08:14 but support doesn't have the commit hash.
deploy-bot: [08:14:07] deployment promoted: canary -> main (service=model-registry) commit=7a9b2f1
Samir (eng-runtime): I pulled the model metadata from registry for commit 7a9b2f1: embedding_dim=2048. previous commit (6f4d9a3) had embedding_dim=1280. looks like the promoted commit changed the encoder head shape. that's why the customer's local index expects 1280 vectors.
Nina (sre): is the pinned alias supposed to be immutable? pin should have prevented a dimension-changing promotion. either the pin was moved to point to a new commit or the alias was accidentally repointed. samir — can you check alias->commit mapping history?
Samir (eng-runtime): checking alias history... found that pin-09c3 alias was recreated by a script as part of automated model tagging. alias metadata shows: 
```
pin-09c3 -> commit 6f4d9a3 (created 2026-02-20 07:50)
then updated -> commit 7a9b2f1 (updated 2026-03-01 08:13) by ci-bot
```
So the pin was overwritten rather than creating a new alias. root cause: our tag-updater allowed alias replacement if the tag was older than X days — bad behavior for pinned aliases.
Devon (eng-ml): that explains it. mitigation options for the customer: 1) temporarily route their requests to a fallback model that still has dim=1280 (open-embed-2-x-legacy), 2) reindex their corpus to accept 2048 vectors (costly), or 3) we roll back the pin to 6f4d9a3 if they require immediate fidelity.
Maya (support): customer asked for the least disruptive option; they prefer we roll back the pin while they plan a reindex. can we do a safe rollback that doesn't affect other customers?
Samir (eng-runtime): yes — we can repoint pin-09c3 back to commit 6f4d9a3. checklist: 1) confirm no other customers are actively using that alias expecting 2048, 2) perform pin update in registry, 3) invalidate cache in serving plane for the alias to ensure requests go to old commit. we should schedule a 5-min window and notify infra.
Nina (sre): I'll run a quick query to find traffic to pin-09c3 in last 24h. if low (<= 3 customers) we can do immediate rollback with a short maintenance notice.
Nina (sre): query done — only 2 tenants used pin-09c3 in the last 24h (acme and internal-eval). both show traffic spike at 08:14-08:20 correlated with the promotion. ok to proceed.
Devon (eng-ml): engineering action items: (A) revert alias -> 6f4d9a3, (B) patch tag-updater to prevent alias replacement for pinned aliases and add an audit log, (C) add model metadata check during rollout to warn if embedding_dim changes and require explicit force flag.
Samir (eng-runtime): scheduling rollback now. I'll run through commands: 
```
# preview
GET /model-registry/aliases/pin-09c3
# set back
POST /model-registry/aliases/pin-09c3
{"target_commit":"6f4d9a3","force":false}
```
I'll trigger cache invalidation on serving nodes after confirmation.
deploy-bot: [08:45:20] alias update requested by samir (id=task-4821)
Samir (eng-runtime): done. alias now points to 6f4d9a3. invalidated serving cache for alias pin-09c3. rolling restart of inference-proxies for alias fans.
Maya (support): customer confirmed after 08:52 that their ingestion pipeline is back to normal and errors stopped. they still need time to reindex for future model upgrades. they requested a postmortem and a timeline of what changed and how we'll prevent this.
Devon (eng-ml): thanks. i'll own an internal postmortem + follow-ups: - patch tag-updater to block alias overwrites for pinned aliases - add a pre-promotion check that compares embedding_dim and warns in the promotion UI and API - document recommended reindexing strategy in the support KB and include sample scripts to pad/truncate vectors if needed for short-term compatibility.
Maya (support): noted. i'll send the customer the rollback confirmation, suggested mitigations (fallback routing + reindex plan + timeline), and the postmortem when ready. closing the incident after postmortem review. :thumbsup:
Samir (eng-runtime): one more note for ops: we should add a metric/alert for sudden embedding_dim changes on alias -> emit an event when metadata changes so support is auto-notified.
Nina (sre): agreed. i'll add an alert to the infra board for metadata diffs during promotion.
